$comment: Source of truth for the difficulty editor. Tabs, row order, setting labels and preset values are transcribed from the in-game Difficulty screen; option labels are the readme's option names (enshrouded_server_readme.txt), which sometimes differ from the in-game wording. Keys, ranges and option values follow Keen's official 'Server Gameplay Settings' article. Conflict policy: Keen's documentation wins, and every conflict was tested on a real server and the result recorded in a $verified field (see docs/game-server-behavior.md); the shipped default file and the mornedhels docs are secondary. Durations are nanoseconds in JSON, minutes in the UI. Server behavior: out-of-range numbers are clamped; an invalid enum string stops the server from booting.

settings.label: Enemy Damage
settings.description: Scales all enemy damage by this value. Excludes bosses.

settings.label: Boss Damage
settings.description: Scales the damage of boss attacks.

settings.label: Enemy Health
settings.description: Scales all enemy health by this value, except bosses.

settings.label: Boss Health
settings.description: Scales the health of all bosses by this value.

settings.label: Enemy Stamina
settings.description: Scales enemy stamina. Higher stamina means enemies take longer to stun. Excludes bosses.

settings.label: Enemy Perception Range
settings.description: Scales how far enemies can see and hear the player. Excludes bosses.

settings.label: Pacify Enemies
settings.description: Enemies won't attack players until attacked first. Excludes bosses.

settings.label: Simultaneous Enemy Attacks
settings.$verified: Verified on a real server: 'Few' boots, is kept, and shows 'Easy' in game.
settings.description: How many enemies are allowed to attack at the same time.

settings.label: Enemy Attack Frequency
settings.description: Scales how often enemies attack. Excludes bosses.

settings.label: Enemy Amount
settings.description: Controls the number of enemies in the world. When Automatic is set, the number of enemies scales depending on the size of the party. A party includes every player actively playing in the vicinity. Players in other areas are not counted as part of the party.
settings.$verified: Verified on a real server: 'Many' and 'Extreme' boot and are kept. In game, 'Many' shows 'More' and 'Extreme' shows 'Many'. 'Automatic' comes from Keen's 1.0.0.0 readme and hasn't been tested on a real server yet.

settings.label: Player Health
settings.description: Scales the maximum player health.

settings.label: Player Mana
settings.description: Scales players' maximum mana.

settings.label: Player Stamina
settings.description: Scales players' maximum stamina.

settings.label: Frost Resistance Duration
settings.description: Scales available body heat. Higher means players can stay in very cold areas longer before hypothermia.
settings.$verified: Verified on a real server: 0.75 boots, is kept, and shows 75% in game.

settings.label: Diving Time
settings.description: Scales initial oxygen, and therefore time available underwater.

settings.label: Mining XP
settings.description: Scales XP from mining resources.

settings.label: Quest & Exploration XP
settings.description: Scales XP from exploring and completing quests.

settings.label: Combat XP
settings.description: Scales XP from combat.

settings.label: Starvation Mode
settings.description: Enables hunger and starvation. Players need to eat or drink regularly to survive; while starving they lose health until death.

settings.label: Time until starvation
settings.description: How long the hungry state lasts before starving begins.
settings.$comment: In-game shows '—' when Starvation Mode is off (dependsOn); the value still exists in JSON.

settings.label: Time in the Shroud
settings.description: Scales how long characters can remain inside the Shroud.

settings.label: Loot Loss On Death
settings.description: What players lose on death. Add Backpack Materials leaves their materials in a tombstone to recover; Everything leaves all their items there; No Tombstone means they keep everything.

settings.label: Day Duration
settings.description: Length of daytime.

settings.label: Night Duration
settings.description: Length of nighttime.
settings.$verified: Verified on a real server: 3600000000000 boots, is kept (not clamped to 30 min), and shows '1h' in game.

settings.label: Food Buff Duration
settings.description: Scales how long food buffs last.

settings.label: Weapon Durability
settings.description: Whether weapons lose durability.

settings.label: Harsh Weather Occurrences
settings.description: How often new weather phenomena appear.

settings.label: Glider Turbulences
settings.description: If off, the glider ignores air turbulence (legacy behavior).

settings.label: Taming Startle Repercussion
settings.description: What happens to taming progress (hearts) when wildlife is startled.

settings.label: Fishing Difficulty
settings.description: Strength of fish in the fishing minigame. Stronger fish take longer.

settings.label: Curse Chance
settings.description: Chance of being cursed by the Shroud when attacked. Easy turns curses off; Hard doubles the chance.
settings.$verified: Verified on a real server: server accepts only Easy/Normal/Hard, so mornedhels' 'Off' would stop the server. 'Easy' boots and shows 'Off' in game.

settings.label: Flame Level for Altars in the Shroud
settings.description: The Flame level needed before Flame Altars can be placed inside the Shroud.
settings.$comment: Added in game version 1.0.0.0 (readme: default 11, options 0-20). The server writes 11 into existing configs. Per-preset values aren't known yet; 11 for all.

settings.label: Workshop Production Speed
settings.description: Scales the speed of production for workshop items.

settings.label: Plant Growth Speed
settings.description: Scales plant growth speed.

settings.label: Weapon Upgrade Cost
settings.description: Scales Runes required to upgrade weapons.

settings.label: Weapon Upgrade Recycling Yield
settings.description: Share of Runes returned when salvaging upgraded weapons.
settings.$comment: Default 0.5 confirmed by the shipped file, Keen's default JSON and the in-game Default column (50%).

settings.label: Mining Damage
settings.description: Higher mining damage means more terraforming and more resources per hit.

settings.label: Loot Amount
settings.description: Scales materials per loot stack from chests, enemies, etc.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Players get this role by entering this password when joining

fields.label: Edit base
fields.description: Add, remove and terraform blocks and props in bases

fields.label: Extend base
fields.description: Create, upgrade and remove Flame Altars

fields.label: Reserved slots
fields.description: Slots held open for this role; the server looks full to other roles

roles.$comment: Templates match the four roles the server writes into a fresh enshrouded_server.json. The server generates random passwords of the form <RoleName><random chars>. Permission meanings (official): canEditWorld = change the world outside bases; canEditBase = add/remove/terraform blocks and props in bases; canExtendBase = create/upgrade/remove Flame Altars; canAccessInventories = open chests/containers; canKickBan = kick and ban players. reservedSlots keeps slots open for that role: the lobby looks full to other roles. No documented limit on role count or password rules.

server.label: Voice chat mode
server.$comment: Verified on a real server: accepted values are Global and Proximity.

server.label: Server tags
server.description: Server browser tags. Fixed list (DedicatedServerTagFlag); an unknown tag stops the server from booting. Verified on a real server, see docs/game-server-behavior.md.

presetDescriptions.Default: This is a balanced preset and is recommended as first time experience for most players. Enemy amount and difficulty is challenging but not overwhelming.
presetDescriptions.Relaxed: This is the most relaxed and easiest preset. Enemy amount and difficulty are tuned down, while resource gain is increased. If you mainly love to build huge bases, this is the mode for you.
presetDescriptions.Hard: If you love a challenging combat experience, this preset is for you. There are more enemies in the game world, they attack more often and deal more damage.
presetDescriptions.Survival: Choose this difficulty if the “Hard” preset is too forgiving. In “Survival”, you will gain less XP and have lower health. Additional survival mechanics like hunger are introduced.
presetDescriptions.Custom: Uses the individual values below. gameSettings is only applied when this preset is selected.

legacyTopLevel.password: Deprecated. If present and non-empty, the server creates a role named 'default' with Friend-like permissions using it. The controller must never write it; on import, offer to convert it into a role and remove it.
